method: Built-in image_gen; new original artwork using the existing straight floral border and illuminated acanthus as inspiration only.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Generate ONE ORIGINAL NEW rectangular illuminated manuscript frame, a fresh artistic interpretation that blends golden floral borders with illuminated acanthus.

The supplied images are INSPIRATION ONLY. Do not reuse, trace, copy, repair, composite, tile, or reconstruct either existing artwork. Every flower, leaf, stem and corner must be newly drawn.
Reference 1 offers inspiration for an ochre-gold painted field, olive botanical vines, small red and cream flowers, muted blue accents, and slender red rules.
Reference 2 offers inspiration for illuminated acanthus: scalloped curling leaves in blue, brick red and gold, subtle worn pigment, fine sepia outlines and scratched ivory veins.
Invent a coherent new botanical pattern merging these qualities. Do not reproduce the particular flowers, repeat cycle or arrangements in either reference.

Make one complete landscape rectangular frame, approximately 5:4 aspect ratio (around 1536x1216). Use a fairly slender constant-width painted band, around 80–90 pixels wide on all four sides. Keep a very large empty transparent rectangular center. The band has a warm muted ochre-gold ground, bounded by fine red and pale-gold rules. On it, weave an original flowing olive vine with newly designed small cream-and-red flowers, occasional muted-blue rosettes, buds, and graceful cobalt, red and gold acanthus curls. The golden floral rhythm should remain prominent; the acanthus should be organically integrated, not applied as extra decorations. Clear gold breathing room between motifs; lively but restrained, readable at a 28–40px border width on a webpage.

The four corners must be drawn as integral parts of the complete design: natural uninterrupted stems turn through 90 degrees, with intact leaves and small blossoms arranged sensibly around each turn. Keep the corner decoration within the same narrow band. Clean continuous inner and outer rectangular rules. No enlarged corner bouquets or separate L-shaped ornaments.

Balanced natural asymmetry: the top and bottom should have similar weight but different flower arrangements and leaf shapes; likewise left and right. Draw each corner individually. No mirrored, rotated, duplicated or cloned compositions. Delicate handmade variation, harmonious overall.

Medium: flat hand-painted manuscript ornament, matte muted mineral pigments, softly rubbed ochre gold, olive greens, restrained cobalt and brick red, cream flowers, fine dark sepia contours and delicate worn ivory highlights. No 3D, embossing, shiny metallic effects or drop shadows.

Deliver only ONE complete new frame on a genuinely transparent background, including a fully transparent center. The golden border band itself is opaque. All edges fully visible with a small transparent outside margin. No paper background, checkerboard pixels, portrait, logo, lettering, sample page, contact sheet, extra pieces or swatches.
